key_impacts: Nationally, 243,191 houses washed away and 370,587 partially damaged
In Dakshin Bedkashi, 33 people were killed
3,520 houses washed away and 1,800 partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi
Almost the entire Dakshin Bedkashi Union was inundated
Embankment overtopped and breached in six places; 20.55 km damaged
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65‑knot winds and a 2–6 m storm surge
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila killed 33 people and washed away 3,520 houses; 1,800 partially damaged; almost the entire union inundated
Storm surge overtopped and breached the coastal embankment in six places, damaging 20.55 km
